title: Body Glitch: Blip the shape-shifter
sources: British Heart Foundation / Cleveland Clinic: a resting adult heart beats about 100,000 times a day (60-100 bpm)
Smithsonian National Zoo, 'Octopus': octopuses have three hearts (two branchial, one systemic)
Smithsonian Ocean / NOAA Fisheries: shark skeletons are cartilage, with no bones
Li et al. 2005, PLoS Genetics, 'Pseudogenization of a sweet-receptor gene accounts for cats' indifference toward sugar' (Tas1r2)

lines.text: This is Blip, and he turns into whatever I talk about.
lines.caps: This is *Blip | he turns *into | whatever I *talk about

lines.text: Your heart beats a hundred thousand times a day.
And a cat can't even taste sugar.
Follow, and see what he becomes next.
